profile.headline: Software Developer, Data Scientist, Snake Charmer
profile.summary: Driven and innovative data scientist with a strong foundation in software engineering, passionate about leveraging advanced techniques and scalable systems to build impactful solutions that transform challenges into opportunities. Dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions at scale while continuously expanding technical expertise.

positions.title: Associate Software Developer
positions.locationName: San Antonio, Texas, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Supports technical development on automated document processing using OpenText Intelligent Capture, both maintaining the application as well as providing tools and analytics to better support other developers
Built, deployed, and currently supporting an application using Python, Docker, and AWS Batch for entity matching of carriers in database of 10 million+ records
Developing new deep learning model to reduce noise and improve image quality in scanned documents using PyTorch
Developed highly scalable ETL Application using Python and AWS Step Functions designed to process 10 million+ documents a year
Advising selection of new Intelligent Document Processing system, including performing analysis on ~10,000 insurance records from multiple vendors as well as providing analytics for other departments.

positions.title: Application Support Analyst
positions.locationName: San Antonio, Texas, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Provided phone and email support for over 200 applications across the Military Health System, answering 500+ calls/month while consistently maintaining Quality Assurance scores >95%
Excelled in first call resolution, resolving 10-20% more tickets than other comparable agents
Created support documentation for agents detailing proper procedures for submitting prescription activation and refill requests to military pharmacies through the MHS Genesis Patient Portal
Maintained excellent customer service, even at high call volume, averaging 4.5/5 or higher survey scores
positions.insights: Software Troubleshooting, Communication Skils and +2 skills

positions.title: Lead Intern and Project Coordinator
positions.description:
* Worked directly with the CEO to design and develop mobile game
Implemented game logic and integrated requested features and innovative game play mechanics 

* Built minimal viable product using Unity game engine

* Used Apple TestFlight for feedback and play testing
* Delivered samples, mock-ups, interfaces, and the finished product per specifications prior to deadline

positions.title: Various
positions.description: Worked for a number of years in various positions, including busboy, host, bartender, and server. Learned invaluable people skills, management ability, and how to work on the fly.

projects.title: Classification Project
projects.description: Created a model to predict customer churn within the Telco dataset. Using machine learning algorithms, the model takes in data from an SQL server and predicts whether or not a customer will churn based on features such as the number of add-ons a customer has and their tenure as a customer. The final model was able to predict customer churn with 68% greater precision than the baseline

projects.title: Clustering Project
projects.description: Used regression-based machine learning to predict the tax value of single family home properties in the Zillow dataset. The data was pulled from an SQL server, prepared, and examined for drivers of the tax value, including the number of bedrooms and bathrooms, and the calculated square footage of the house. This data was then used to create a model which was able to predict the tax value 28% more accurately than the baseline.
